It then shot off diagonally to the South-Southwest at a speed faster than any of it's earlier movements and disappeared. I often spend time watching for another similar light but have seen nothing in the 10 + years since. It is important to note that in 1992 the army base at Fort McLelland, which is now closed, was still open. Fort McLelland is South-Southeast of Weiss Lake where the sighthing occurred. MUFON investigators had difficulty getting the rattled family to talk about what they saw.
